apps.name: Book Scout
apps.description: Scan books and see instantly whether Ziffit will buy them. Tracks your haul and profit.

apps.name: ClockSync
apps.description: Sets the clock from internet time servers at every boot and whenever the network connects.

apps.name: App Store
apps.description: This app. Install it here to keep a permanent copy in \Application that updates itself.

apps.name: TlsProbe
apps.description: Diagnostic for the CeTls project: records how TLS is set up on this device and writes TlsProbe.txt next to itself. Read-only.

apps.name: CeTls Spy
apps.description: Diagnostic for the CeTls project: logs how programs use secure sockets (passes everything through unchanged; never logs data). Open it to switch on or off.

apps.name: SchShadow
apps.description: Diagnostic for CeTls: for about a minute, puts a logging stand-in for the TLS library (schannel.dll) in place to see what Internet Explorer's HTTPS code asks of it, then restores the original. Soft-reset first.

apps.name: RootTest
apps.description: Diagnostic for CeTls: checks whether the device can trust modern certificates once it has a modern root. Adds ISRG Root X1 (Let's Encrypt) to the root store and tests before and after. Uninstall removes the root again.

apps.name: CeTls
apps.description: Modern TLS for the whole device: replaces the TLS library Internet Explorer and other programs use, adding TLS 1.2 and SNI (TLS 1.0/1.1 still work). Open it to install, test or remove; a clean boot also puts the original back.
